Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The umpires and the Afghanistan players are out on the field. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis will open the inning for Sri Lanka. Fazalhaq Farooqi will begin proceedings with the new ball. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Afghanistan have a good total on the board and will feel they are ahead in this game. The pitch may wear out a bit to assist their spinners and with their pace bowlers looking dangerous, they will be eager to get some early wickets. Sri Lanka will have the scoreboard pressure on them and once again the onus will lie on Pathum Nissanka to get them off to a good start. However, this has to be a team effort and the form of the other batters is quite a worry for the home side. Will they be able to get out of their slump and pull off a remarkable run-chase? Or will the visitors continue their domination and clinch the series? Do join us shortly for the reply to find out.

Kasun Rajitha carried his good form from the last match and got Sri Lanka off to a wonderful start taking a wicket early. He came back in his second spell to claim another and when Dhananjaya de Silva took the third wicket, it looked like Sri Lanka were well in control of the game. They could not press home their advantage though in the middle overs and their star spinner Wanindu Hasaranga was taken apart by the opponents. Despite the hammering, he came back to take two wickets but he would have liked to have bowled with much more discipline. It was an interesting day for the Sri Lankan bowlers as they were not very expensive as none of the bowlers conceded more than 7 runs in an over but none of them was able to put the shackles to have an economy of less than 5. Kasun Rajitha was once again the pick of the bowlers taking another three-wicket haul but it could be all in vain if the batters do not perform.

Afghanistan did not get off to the best of starts losing their dangerous opener Rahmanullah Gurbaz early but Ibrahim Zadran and Rahmat Shah steadied the ship to take Afghanistan through Powerplay 1. However, the wickets of Rahmat Shah and skipper Hashmatullah Shahidi had them in a spot of bother as they had lost three wickets for 57 runs in the 15th over. However, the Zadrans had their own plans as they put on a 154-run partnership for the fourth wicket to get Afghanistan over the 200-run mark with ample overs to spare. Najibullah Zadran was dismissed for 77 and Mohammad Nabi could not really get going thereafter as he hauled out looking to accelerate. Gulbadin Naib did not last long but in the end, it was all about Ibrahim Zadran as he played all 50 overs before being dismissed on the last ball and scored 162 runs off 138 balls to take his team well beyond the 300-run mark.

What an outstanding inning from Ibrahim Zadran! He notched up the highest individual score by an Afghanistan player in ODI cricket and that helped his team post 313 on the board. It seems like a formidable target and Sri Lanka have a mountain to climb here if they are to save this series. The Afghans have put on quite a show here and it is now in the hands of their bowlers to take them beyond the finish line.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ibrahim Zadran is dismissed on the final ball of the innings. Asitha Fernando delivers a full toss around off, at 136 kph, Ibrahim clears his front leg and heaves across the line. The ball comes from the top part of his bat and flies straight to deep mid-wicket. Pathum Nissanka takes the skier safely. Afghanistan end on 313 for 8.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Asitha Fernando

Commentary.Commentary: Slower in space, a touch short on middle at 111 kph, Zadran plays a mistimed heave over mid-wicket and rushes back to complete the second run.
Misses out! Full toss around leg, Zadran swings his bat early and fails to make any connection. Ibrahim Zadran is disappointed with himself.
Another couple. Yorker around leg, Zadran steps back and steers it past short third man. Maheesh Theekshana chases it down and they get two runs.
Spears in a very full ball on middle, Zadran whips it to wide long on and scampers back for the second run.
SIX! What a start to the last over! Slower one, outside leg, a bit short, Ibrahim Zadran turns inside the crease as he kneels down and muscles it over long leg for a maximum.
Full toss outside off, Noor mistimes his shot down to long on and rushes back for the second run. 300 comes up!
Noor Ahmad walks out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wide yorker outside off, at 94 kph, Rashid Khan reaches out to squeeze it away over point but only manages to slice it into the hands of Dinesh Chandimal at backward point. He completes the catch with a jump and Kasun Rajitha has his third wicket in the match.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Chandimal b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Too full and outside off, Khan squeezes it out to point.
Unorthodox Rashid. Fetches a full ball from outside off, kneels down and wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and wide outside off, driven to deep cover for a single. 150 up fro Ibrahim Zadran!
FOUR! Finds the gap! Back of a length, in the region outside off and on the slower side, Ibrahim Zadran walks down the track and smashes it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Ibrahim Zadran moves to 145 - the highest individual score in ODIs in Pallekele. Floated and full, outside off, Zadran drives it square of the wicket on the off side and collects a single.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy and full, around off, Ibrahim drives it crisply through extra cover for a couple of runs.
SIX! Dismissed! Maheesh Theekshana delivers it full and around off, Ibrahim Zadran clears his front leg and fires it over long off for a biggie.

Appeal for an lbw, not given! Flighted and outside off, Khan tries to play the reverse sweep but misses. It goes off the pads to short fine leg and they cross as the bowler appeals. Nothing from the umpire. It's reviwed by Dasun Shanaka. The Ball Tracking shows that the impact is outside off. One leg bye is added to the total.

Loopy and full, around leg, Rashid tries to slog but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to the off side and they cross. The keeper has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Dasun Shanaka is unable to back up the throw and they cross for an overthrow.
Shortish and around off, dabbed down towards backward point for a single.
Full and wide outside off, stroked to deep cover for a run.
Kasun Rajitha bangs this in short and in line with the stumps, Rashid Khan pulls this awkwardly to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Rashid Khan joins the party! Kasun Rajitha bowls a slower delivery full and outside off. Rashid Khan uses his high back-lift to generate power and thumps the ball towards long off. The fielder puts in a dive but the ball creeps under him towards the fence for four runs.
Kasun Rajitha serves a full delivery this time outside off, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this to long off and takes one.

FOUR! That is sheer power from Ibrahim Zadran! Kasun Rajitha bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran uses brute strength to smash the ball down to long off for four runs. The fielder was present but he had no chance of getting to the ball.
Floats this full and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran eases this down to long on and takes a single to keep strike.

Yorker around leg, Khan digs it out through mid on and takes a single. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but the keeper had moved out in anticipation to back the throw at the bowler's end. No one is present behind the stumps at the keeper's end and Afghanistan get two more runs.
Fuller and quicker on off, defended back.
Tossed up outside off, driven to covers for a run.
Rashid Khan is the new batter to make his way out to the field.

OUT! Run out! Flatter delivery around middle, Ibrahim Zadran goes deep inside the crease and punches it to mid-wicket. Gulbadin Naib leaves the crease, in search of a run and Dasun Shanaka immediately has a shy at the bowler's end. Maheesh Theekshana grabs the ball and breaks the stumps. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. This is close. The replays find that Maheesh grabs the ball with his palms and uses his little finger to clip the bails. That's clever if intentional. The batter is short of the crease and Sri Lanka have a breakthrough at the backend of the innings.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and forces it past the bowler to long off. They cross.
Maheesh Theekshana has been brought back into the attack. He has conceded 29 runs in his 5 overs without any success.
Uppish but safe! Pace off, on a length around middle, Ibrahim Zadran is early into the shot and chips it behind the bowler. Another couple from the over.
One more yorker, outside off, it's dug out to the off side for one.
Another yorker around leg, Naib nudges it to fine leg and comes back for the second rum.
Yorker around leg, Ibrahim Zadran seems to get some part of his bat behind it and sends the ball to fine leg. They cross. The umpire signals for a leg bye.
Another brace. Full and around leg, Ibrahim plays it with soft hands and helps it through mid-wicket.
Full toss around middle, Zadran lifts it over extra cover. Chandimal races across to his left from long off and makes a sliding stop. Saves two.
Flatter around off, it's forced to sweeper cover for a single. Wanindu Hasaranga is done with his spell.
Very full on middle, it's dug out down to long on for one.
Spinning in from around off, Naib sticks back and helps it to short mid-wicket.
Quicker and on the pads, Zadran hits it to deep square leg for one. 250 up!
Spinning in from middle, it's worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Short around off, cut off the back foot to deep point for a run.
A dipping full toss outside off, 101 kph, Ibrahim Zadran strokes it to sweeper cover for one. Excellent over from Kasun Rajitha. The last two overs have been excellent from the home team.
Full and outside off, 104 kph, Naib drives through covers for a single.
Wide! Kasun Rajitha loses his radar and slips a full ball way wide outside off, Naib leaves.
A gentle full toss outside off, at 102 kph, Zadran mistimes his shot down to long on, for just a run.
Very full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran throws his hands at it but fails to make any connection.
Back of a length, around off and angling in, Gulbadin Naib nudges it down to long on and gets off the mark with a single.
A low full toss outside off, Ibrahim shapes up for the paddle shot but then changes his mind and pushes it towards short third man. The fielder there misfields and they cross.

Beauty! Loopy and around off, fuller in length, Gulbadin Naib tries to defend but it skids past the outside edge and misses the off stump by a whisker. Rare good over from Wanindu Hasaranga in this match.
Fuller on off, helped to mid-wicket.
Flighted and full outside off, Naib watches the line and makes a leave.
Gulbadin Naib walks out to the middle.

OUT! Nabi holes out! Another googly, too full and around off, Mohammad Nabi stands back and tries to heave across the line. But it comes off from the lower part of the blade and flies towards long on. A simple catch for Pathum Nissanka in the deep and Wanindu Hasaranga has his second wicket. He is not too happy though. It's been an expensive day for him.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Crunched! An attempted googly but the length is too full, Mohammad Nabi picks the variation early, leans forward and crunches it through extra cover.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.

FOUR! Connects and connects supremely this time. A juicy half-volley outside off, Ibrahim Zadran leans into the drive and transfers his weight into the shot. Finds the gap at extra cover and the ball speeds away to the fence. 11 from the over and Afghanistan have started the last phase of this inning on a high!
Beaten! Kasun takes the pace off again, delivers it on a length and wide outside off, Zadran reaches out but fails to connect.
Slower one, on a length and outside off, Nabi hits it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Short in length and outside off, at 131 kph, Nabi stands tall to fetch it from out there and jabs it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Edgy! Change in pace, it's slow and full outside off, Zadran pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man. They cross.
Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Nabi eases it down to fine leg for a run.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. Kasun Rajitha is back on. 2 for 22 in his 6 overs thus far.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran drives this straight to the cover fielder.
Fired into the pads on a fuller length, Mohammad Nabi clips the ball to deep backward square leg for a single.
Short once again and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran goes on his back foot and hits the ball to long off for a run.
This is slightly short and outside off, Mohammad Nabi forces the ball towards long off and gets off strike with a single.
Goes full once again and straight, Mohammad Nabi miscues this to the left of the mid-wicket fielder.
Wanindu Hasaranga floats this full and into the pads, Mohammad Nabi clips this ball towards mid-wicket.
Bowls this one back of a length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran looks to punch this towards the off side but gets beaten by the extra bounce. 12 from the over!

FOUR! Make that three boundaries in the over! Asitha Fernando gets his line all wrong as he strays down leg side on a fuller length. Ibrahim Zadran gets low and works the ball past the short fine leg fielder for four more runs.

FOUR! Ibrahim Zadran looking to take the initiative now! Asitha Fernando bowls a slower delivery on a length and outside the off stump. Ibrahim Zadran charges down the wicket and pulls the ball toward deep mid-wicket for the second boundary of the over.
This is on a good length and just outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran defends this back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Ibrahim Zadran gets to his second century in this series! What good form he has been in and has dug Afghanistan out of a hole! Asitha Fernando bangs this in short and angling down leg, Ibrahim Zadran pulls this into the gap at deep backward square leg and collects four runs. So, Ibrahim continues to have zero fifties in ODIs as every time he crosses the 50-run mark, he makes a century, third so far.
Asitha Fernando bowls this one on good length and outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran defends the ball towards short cover.
This is slightly short and straight, Mohammad Nabi gets on his back foot and punches the ball towards mid on.
Floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Mohammad Nabi defends this back towards the bowler.
Mohammad Nabi walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wanindu Hasaranga has got his man! Najibullah Zadran has played a wonderful knock but has to make the long walk back to the shed! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls this full and on a leg stumps line, Najibullah Zadran looks to flick this past mid-wicket but ends up chipping it toward the fielder. Dasun Shanaka takes a fine catch diving forward but does not claim the wicket straight away. The umpires go upstairs to check and the third umpire reckons the fingers were under the ball. Sri Lanka finally have the breakthrough and that brings an end to a wonderful partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a clean catch? The umpires get together and then refer it upstairs. The soft signal is not out. Dasun Shanaka is unsure and the third umpire will need concrete evidence to overrule the soft signal. Looking touch and go in the replays. Fingers underneath the ball, says Raveendra Wimalasiri. Najibullah Zadran exits and the crowd roars.

SIX! The onslaught continues and Wanindu Hasaranga is taking a pounding here! Another flighted delivery bowled full and just outside the off pole, Najibullah Zadran uses his feet once again and connects this better. The ball sails over the long off boundary for a maximum.

FOUR! Najibullah Zadran looking to target the bowler here! Wanindu Hasaranga flights this full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran charges down the wicket and gets the ball to the left of mid off for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran gets an outside edge towards short third man. They decide against taking a single.
Short and outside off, Najibullah Zadran cuts the ball to deep point and takes a run to keep strike.
Fires this one full and into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran clips this towards deep square leg for a single. That brings up 200 runs for Afghanistan and this has been a wonderful recovery from them!
Continues bowling full now and aims for the stumps, Najibullah Zadran works the ball to long off and takes one.
This is full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran taps the ball towards cover.

FOUR! The boundaries are flowing now! Maheesh Theekshana is slightly short once again, Najibullah Zadran transfers his body weight on the back foot and pulls the ball toward deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this slightly short and just outside off, Ibrahim Zadran gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Fires this one full and into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran forces this down to long on for a run.
This is full as well and straight, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran tucks this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! This is another good-looking shot! Dhananjaya de Silva bowls a loopy delivery full and outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran powers this over mid off and gets a boundary.
This is full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran hits this straight back to the bowler who lets the ball go through his legs for a run.
Dhananjaya de Silva bowls this slightly short and straight, Ibrahim Zadran goes on the back foot and works the ball to long on for a single.
Bowls a quicker delivery in line with the stumps, Najibullah Zadran defends this back towards the bowler.
Another googly bowled full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran taps this towards short third man.

FOUR! Wanindu Hasaranga has got his length all wrong in this game! This is short and outside off, Najibullah Zadran cuts this to deep point and finds the boundary once again. Four more runs added to his kitty.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this down to long on for a single.
A googly bowled full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran is beaten but Kusal Mendis is unable to collect this cleanly. They take a bye.

FOUR! Najibullah Zadran has taken a liking to Wanindu Hasaranga! This is a flighted delivery bowled full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran gives himself room and hits the ball over the mid off fielder for four runs.
Bowls this slightly short and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran rocks back in the crease and punches this to deep cover. They come back for a brace.
This is outside the off stump on a fuller length, Najibullah Zadran knocks this to long off and takes one.
Flighted delivery bowled full and angled into the stumps, Najibullah Zadran looks to play at this but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! That is FIFTY for Najibullah Zadran! Dhananjaya de Silva serves this full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran gets a good stride forward and crunches the ball through the gap for four runs to deep cover.
Bowls this full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran strokes this towards extra cover.
WIDE! Fires this one full and down leg. Najibullah Zadran misses his flick and the umpire calls this wide.
Dhananjaya de Silva starts off after the break with a fullish delivery just outside off, Ibrahim Zadran eases this down to long on for a single.

Drinks break. All thanks to the Zadrans, Afghanistan have bossed the middle overs after early hiccups. Both Ibrahim and Najibullah are looking set and the Afghans are heading towards a strong finish. Sri Lanka need wickets to limit the damage in the end overs. Will they succeed? Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl after the break.
This is fired into the stumps on a fuller length, Najibullah Zadran taps this towards the leg side. 10 runs from the over and Wanindu Hasaranga is proving to be quite expensive here.
Flighted delivery full and bowled on the leg stump line, Ibrahim Zadran shimmies down the wicket and clips the ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Afghanistan but they will take them all! Wanindu Hasaranga flights this one full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran pushes at the ball and gets an outside edge. There is no slip present and the ball races away to the third man fence for another boundary.
This is short as well and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga gets away with it this time as the ball is played to deep point for a single.
Sri Lanka need a wicket from their premier spin bowler.
FOUR! This has been slapped away! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls this short and outside off, Najibullah Zadran uses the depth of the crease and punches this to deep cover for four runs.
Bowls a googly full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran defends this to the right of the bowler.
Delivers this one full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this straight to the cover fielder. 10 from the over!

That brings up the 100-run partnership between these two players! Asitha Fernando bowls this on a good length but strays onto the pads, Ibrahim Zadran clips this to the right of mid-wicket and they collect two runs. This partnership is setting a nice platform for Afghanistan going toward the back end of the inning.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over for Ibrahim Zadran! Asitha Fernando bowls this slightly full and just outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran clears his front foot out of the way and thumps this straight back past the bowler for another boundary.
Continues bowling back of a length but this time outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran taps the ball towards point.
This is bowled back of a length and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran tucks this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Ibrahim Zadran is looking really good here! Asitha Fernando bowls a low full toss outside off, Ibrahim Zadran times this perfectly and finds the gap at deep cover for four runs.
This is in line with the stumps and on a fuller length, Ibrahim Zadran flicks this to deep square leg and collects a run.

Falls short of the fielder in the deep! Dunith Wellalage flights this full and just outside off, Najibullah Zadran gives him the charge once again but miscues the shot towards mid-wicket. The ball lands safely and they take a single.
Another full delivery angled into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran clips this down to long on for a run.
Goes short this time and outside off, Najibullah Zadran rocks back in the crease and plays this towards deep cover for a single.

FOUR! Great use of the feet from Najibullah Zadran! Dunith Wellalage flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Najibullah Zadran charges down the wicket and thumps the ball over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Dunith Wellalage bowls a full delivery outside off and serves this slower in the air. Najibullah Zadran knocks this back towards the bowler.

Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran taps this back down the pitch towards the bowler. End of another tight over from Asitha Fernando as just 2 runs have come off it.
Delivers this on a good length and just outside off, Ibrahim Zadran is watchful as he defends the ball solidly back towards the bowler.
Bangs this in short and straight, Najibullah Zadran pulls this towards deep square leg and collects a single.
Bowls this slightly full and in line with the stumps, Najibullah Zadran blocks this towards mid off.
This is on a good length and angling away from the left-hander from outside off. Najibullah Zadran taps the ball towards point.
Asitha Fernando starts the over with a good-length delivery nipping back in from outside off. Ibrahim Zadran pushes at the ball and gets an inside edge to deep backward square leg for a single.
Change. Asitha Fernando comes back into the attack. 0 for 19 in his 5 overs so far.
Full and around off, Najibullah prods forward and eases it through extra cover for a couple of runs.
Too full and on middle, Najibullah Zadran tries to go hard but only scuffs his shot from the bottom edge. It goes on the bounce back to the bowler.
Floated and around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Leans forward and softly pushes a full ball to cover-point for one.
Slightly short and outside off, turning in, Najibullah Zadran rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover. A good stop near the fence and the batters take two.
Dunith Wellalage returns for his second spell and starts with a full ball on middle, it's driven to long off for a single.
Wrong 'un, full and on middle, Najibullah Zadran defends off the front foot.
Goes very full and on off, Ibrahim knocks it down to long on to rotate the strike. Smart!

SIX! Lovely shot! Tossed up, landing full on middle and turning away, Ibrahim Zadran kneels down and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Went against the spin but packed it with great power and timing.
Too full and around off, a googly, Najibullah drives it aerially but wide of mid off. The fielder dives to stop and they cross.
Forces a full ball back to the bowler who dives and parries it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted and full on middle, Ibrahim flicks it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives but fails to make a clean stop. They cross.
Floated and around off, Ibrahim drives and beats the short cover fielder. Picks up a single to end the over.
FOUR! Fine shot! Flatter delivery, around off and it's a carrom ball, Ibrahim Zadran steps back to create room and clobbers it over extra cover for a boundary.
Very full and on off, Najibullah Zadran makes room and drills it down to long off for one.
Lands it full and on middle, Najibullah Zadran defends it back to the bowler.
Leans forward and wrists a full ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and flighted on off, Ibrahim gets forward and defends it back.
Quicker on off, Najibullah goes back and defends it on the leg side.
Loopy on off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
Extra loop on this one, full and dipping in around middle, Ibrahim Zadran plays it past short mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven towards cover-point for one.

Given lbw! Wanindu Hasaranga has struck and running in joy. Najibullah Zadran doesn't agree and decides to take the DRS. It's a flighted delivery, landing full around off and it straightens a hint as Najibullah goes down to play the reverse-batted shot. He misses and is pinged on the front leg. Looks plumb to the naked eye and the umpire also feels the same. Time for the review. UltraEdge takes a long time to load. We're still waiting and in the meantime, Dasun Shanaka gets the time to have a look at the quality of Najibullah Zadran's blade. Now, UltraEdge is loading and there are plenty of murmurs as it approaches the gloves of the batter. The third umpire takes that at face value and overturns the onfield decision. A bit debatable and this decision could have gone either way.
Flatter on middle, worked to square leg.
Tossed up outside off, Najibullah Zadran helps it to long off and retains strike.
Quicker one, this is fired short and on middle, Ibrahim hits it firmly down to long on for one.
Flighted again, around off, it's played down to long off for a run.
FIFTY FOR IBRAHIM! Flighted and full, around off, Ibrahim Zadran eases it down to long on for a single. He has got a great conversation rate, so watch out Sri Lanka!
Flatter and fuller on middle, Najibullah Zadran pushes it to mid on where the fielder dives to make a stop. They cross.
The Zadrans have combined for a 50-run stand! Flighted and around off, Ibrahim Zadran is deceived a bit but does well to loft it behind the bowler for a single.
Slower one, full and angling away, Najibullah Zadran is beaten on drive.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and around leg, at a gentle pace, Najibullah Zadran rides the bounce and pulls it powerfully behind square leg for a boundary.
Pitches it up and around off, it's driven to covers.
Short and on off, Ibrahim guides it down to third man for one.
This one appears to be an inswinger, around off on a fuller length, Ibrahim Zadran tries playing straight but it takes the inner edge and rolls to short fine leg.
Beaten! Dasun Shanaka begins with an away swinger, on a length outside off, Ibrahim Zadran tries to drive but gets beaten.
Well stopped! Too full and outside off, Najibullah Zadran drills it through extra cover. Maheesh Theekshana sprints across to his right from long off and saves two runs with a dive. 100 up!
Very full and around leg, Ibrahim Zadran knocks it down to long on for a run. Maheesh Theekshana fumbles slightly but no extra run is conceded.
Lands it full and on off, it's caressed past extra cover for a run.
Fires it full, on the pads, Ibrahim wrists it behind square leg for a single.
Too full and on off, Najibullah Zadran drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Quicker arm ball on off, defended to the off side.
SIX! Fine shot! Loopy delivery, full and around off, Ibrahim Zadran finds it in his zone and hammers it over wide long on for a maximum.

Appeal for a run out! Flighted outside off, Najibullah Zadran plays it down in front of cover-point and tries to steal a quick run. Charith Asalanka comes up with a direct hit at the striker's end and it's referred upstairs. The replays find Ibrahim Zadran safe.
Quicker and flatter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Full on off, pushed to covers.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up outside off, Najibullah Zadran plays a mistimed drive in the air but it doesn't carry to mid off.
Fuller length outside off, Ibrahim pushes it past the cover fielder for a single.
Aerial but safe! Spinning away from around leg, gripping a bit, Najibullah Zadran tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. The leading edge falls in no man's land at covers.
Shortish and on off, Najibullah Zadran strokes it off the back foot to covers.

Risky single. Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Ibrahim Zadran turns it with soft hands to short fine leg and crosses for a brisk single. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end otherwise Najibullah Zadran would have been a goner.
On middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Floated and full, around off, Najibullah takes his front leg away from the way and drives it to long off for one.
Short and wide outside off, Najibullah Zadran forces it to covers where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Loopy and on middle, Najibullah Zadran quietly eases it through square leg and runs the first run hard. That's all he will get.
Flatter and on middle, it's punched back to the bowler.
Presses forward and drives it through extra cover for a single.
Around off, that is defended solidly off the front foot.

FOUR! Almost a return catch though. A low full toss on off, Ibrahim Zadran hits it straight and from the bottom part of his bat. The ball flies past the bowler who is late with his reflexes. It speeds behind and finds the straight boundary.
Wanindu Hasaranga finally gets the chance to roll his arm and he begins with a full ball on off, Najibullah Zadran strokes it down to long on and picks up a single.
This one is served towards off, it's played down to cover-point for a single.
On middle, tucked through wide mid on for a single.
Skidding away from around off, Ibrahim pushes it towards point. Najibullah Zadran wants a run but is sent back.
Around leg, it's clipped through square leg for a run.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a single.
Gets on the front foot and pushes a full ball to long off for a single.
Shortish around leg, Najibullah Zadran stands on one leg and drags his pull behind to long leg for a single.
Good length around off, pushed through covers for a single.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Afghanistan. Shortish and around middle and leg, Ibrahim Zadran hits across the line in front of square on the leg side. It races away and Charith Asalanka tries to stop the ball with a dive. He fails to do so and it's the first boundary off the bat for Afghanistan after the 8th over.
Alters his length to go short, around off at 137 kph, Ibrahim leans back and attempts to play the ramp shot at the last moment, but misses.
Fuller and on off at 138 kph, Ibrahim pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Back of a length on off, 139 clicks, Ibrahim stays back and taps it down to point. It goes on one bounce to Wanindu Hasaranga.
Flights this one outside off, full in length, Najibullah drives it through covers, finds the gap in the deep and returns for the second run.
Fuller and on off, it's eased down to long on for a run.
A bit short around off, turning down, Ibrahim Zadran flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
Fuller and quicker on off, forced down to long off for one.
Tossed up on middle, fuller in length, Najibullah Zadran works it towards mid-wicket.
Slider around off, full and skidding in, Najibullah Zadran gets forward and defends.
Dhananjaya de Silva has come back on the field and he will continue his spell.
Maiden! Yet another bouncer, around off at 133 kph, Ibrahim Zadran perhaps picks it late and leaves it slightly awkwardly.
Sharp bouncer at 134, around leg and going down, Ibrahim Zadran tries to pull but it flies over his bat.
Sliding down the leg side, Ibrahim works it off his pads but finds short mid-wicket.
Bends his back and digs it in short, around off at 134 kph, Ibrahim Zadran leans back and lets it through to the keeper.
Angling in from middle and leg, good pace, Ibrahim tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Shortish around off, Ibrahim Zadran stays back and chops it down, in front of the keeper.

Sight halt! Dhananjaya de Silva seems to have injured his right shoulder trying to stop the ball. He is on the floor for a long time and is surrounded by his teammates. He is up and moving now which is good news for Sri Lanka but he will go out for some treatment. Asitha Fernando (3-0-13-0) has been brought back into the attack.
Leans forward and knocks a full ball past the diving bowler for a run down to long on. Two good overs from Dhananjaya de Silva and now he has a wicket to his name as well.
Quicker outside off, punched to covers for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Najibullah Zadran drives it back and the bowler gets some touch on the ball as it goes on to break the stumps at the other end. Ibrahim Zadran is well in though.
Skidding down from middle, Najibullah Zadran tries to flick but misses and wears it on his pads.

FOUR! Bonus runs! Flatter and shorter outside off, Najibullah punches it off his back foot to short cover. Hasaranga collects the ball and has an immediate shy at the bowler's end with Ibrahim venturing out. He misses and with no one backing up, the ball races away to the fence.

DRINKS! The wicket has prompted the umpires to take a refreshment break. Sri Lanka will be absolutely thrilled with the start they have got. They have three dangerous batters back in the shed and have not let the Afghans get away with their scoring rate as well. They will now look to press their advantage with spinners in the middle session. Afghanistan are in need of a partnership here and they will be hoping Ibrahim Zadran can carry on and play a big inning. He has been joined by Najibullah Zadran in the middle and he will have to play a part in the rebuild.

OUT! GIVEN LBW! Hashmatullah Shahidi wants the decision to be reviewed. A premeditated charge had him in all sorts of trouble. It's a slider from Dhananjaya de Silva who is a clever operator. Lands it close to off, Shahidi advances down, is deceived in flight and variation. He tries to somehow keep it out but the ball skids on to beat his bat and raps him on the back pad. The appeal is made and the umpire is in agreement. DRS time! Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows three reds. Afghanistan are in a spot of bother with their fragile middle order exposed now.
This is bowled back of a length and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi guides this to third man for a single to keep strike.
Well-directed bouncer by Kasun Rajitha as he gets the batter ducking awkwardly. Good aggression shown by the bowler here.
On a good length and outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran taps this with soft hands towards point and takes off for a quick single.

WIDE! Goes full and fires this one down leg side. Kusal Mendis dives to his right and stops the ball from going down the boundary. The batters run across for an extra run as the umpire calls this wide.
Short once again and just outside the off pole, Hashmatullah Shahidi gets his bat out of the way and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran gets on top of the bounce and pulls the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Kasun Rajitha continues from 'round the wicket to the left-hander. He serves this on a good length and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi works this ball to deep point and takes a run.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi shimmies down the wicket and hits the ball to long off for a single.
Flights this one full and just outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi gets a stride forward and blocks the ball to cover.
This is full as well and in line with middle stump, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this firmly to long on and takes one.
Loopy delivery served full and straight, Ibrahim Zadran tucks it to the leg side.
Goes full and in line with the stumps, Hashmatullah Shahidi strokes the ball to long off and takes a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva starts with a full delivery fired into the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Slower delivery bowled full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran taps this towards point and that brings an end to a successful over for Sri Lanka.
Slightly short and outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran looks to pull but hits the ball straight to mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran defends this towards the cover fielder.

Kasun Rajitha goes 'round the wicket to the southpaw straightaway. Angles this into the pads on a good length, Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to work this leg side but misses and the ball goes off the pads for a leg bye.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kasun Rajitha gets his second and Sri Lanka finally have the breakthrough they have been looking for! This delivery is banged into the pitch and angling down leg, Rahmat Shah looks to pull but gets the upper part of his bat and that makes the ball loop to the keeper's left. Kusal Mendis takes an easy catch and Afghanistan have lost their second wicket. Hashmatullah Shahidi walks in next.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Kasun Rajitha also decides to begin the over with a back-of-a-length delivery served outside off. Ibrahim Zadran works this to deep cover-point for a run.
Decides to end the over with a fullish delivery served outside off, Rahmat Shah taps this towards mid on to end the over with a dot ball.
Bowls this quick and short, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran is happy to work this to deep backward point and take a run.
Goes full this time and angles this into the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran defends this towards cover.
Slightly short once again and outside off, Rahmat Shah plays this to deep point and takes another one.
Another back of a length delivery, this time closer to the off pole. Ibrahim Zadran waits on the ball and guides it to third man for a run.
Asitha Fernando bowls this outside off and back of a length, Rahmat Shah guides this with a cross bat towards deep backward point for a single.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Bowls this on a good length and continues to offer width outside off. Ibrahim Zadran hits this hard but does not find the gap on the off side. Afghanistan are 42 for the loss of 1 wicket after Powerplay 1.
This is delivered back of a length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran gets on his toes and taps the ball towards extra cover.
On a good length this time and outside the off stump, Rahmat Shah works the ball to deep point and takes a single.
Angles this one full into the stumps by going wide of the crease. Rahmat Shah clips this ball towards mid-wicket.
Bowls a gentle delivery full and outside the off stump, Rahmat Shah leaves this alone as the ball stays slightly low.
Kasun Rajitha begins with a full delivery in line with the stumps, Rahmat Shah flicks this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Kasun Rajitha is back into the attack to bowl the final over of Powerplay 1.
This is full and angled into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran clips this to deep backward point and they pick up a couple of runs as the fielder does well to stop the ball.

Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Rahmat Shah plays this with soft hands towards cover-point. The fielder puts in a dive to stop the ball and throws it at the stumps. The ball ricochets off the stumps and the batters take a gifted single.
Goes full and attacks the stumps, Rahmat Shah punches this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this slightly back of a length and gets the ball to rise off the surface. Ibrahim Zadran has enough width to get on top of this and work to deep backward point for a single.
On a good length once again and on the outside off stump channel. Ibrahim Zadran taps the ball to backward point.
Begins with a 142 kmph delivery served on a good length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran blocks this solidly.
Another loopy delivery served in line with the stumps, Rahmat Shah knocks this straight to mid off.
Floats this one full and just outside the off pole, Rahmat Shah shimmies down the wicket and punches the ball back to the bowler.
Goes back to bowling full and outside off, Rahmat Shah clocks this towards short third man.
FOUR! Does not miss out this time! Dunith Wellalage bowls a short delivery wide outside off. Rahmat Shah has all the time in the world to pick his gap and cuts this to deep cover for four runs.
A low full toss served on the pads, Rahmat Shah misses out as he can only play this to mid on.
Dunith Wellalage flights this delivery and serves it full, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran strokes this down to long off for a single.

FOUR! This has been slapped away and it's a good way to end the over for Afghanistan! Asitha Fernando bowls this wide outside the off stump on a fuller length, Rahmat Shah is onto it in a flash and creams it to deep cover-point for a boundary.
Goes full this time and heading for the off pole, Rahmat Shah pushes at the ball and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
This is at 141 kmph and outside the off stump on a good length. Rahmat Shah taps this towards the point fielder.
Bowls this at 140 clicks and back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah defends this firmly towards cover.

What a jaffa! Asitha Fernando bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in slightly. Rahmat Shah plays a loose shot and gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Asitha Fernando begins with a full delivery outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran strokes this firmly towards backward point. The fielder gets a hand on the ball and restricts the score to a run.
Asitha Fernando has been handed the ball now. So change from both sides for Sri Lanka.
Angles this one full and into the pads. Ibrahim Zadran looks to make room and works the ball to long off for a single to keep strike.
Bowls this one full as well and just outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran blocks this to the cover fielder.
Fires this one full and outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran leaves this one alone.
FOUR! That has been crunched! Dunith Wellalage bowls this one slightly short and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran is deep in the crease and punches the ball to deep cover for four runs.
Full once again and outside the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran gets a stride forward and defends the ball towards cover.
Dunith Wellalage starts the over with a full delivery into the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran mistimes his shot towards mid-wicket.
Dunith Wellalage has been brought into the attack.
Pulls his length back and delivers this outside the off stump. Rahmat Shah taps the ball to point and it will be a dot ball to end the over.

FOUR! Great use of the wrists there from Rahmat Shah! Kasun Rajitha bowls this really full but strays onto the pads, Rahmat Shah flicks the ball expertly to the right of the mid-wicket fielder and collects four more runs.
On a good length and outside the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran guides the ball to deep backward point and takes a run.
Goes wide of the crease and serves this full into the pads, Ibrahim Zadran keeps his head still and clips the ball towards short mid-wicket.
Goes full and outside the off stump, Rahmat Shah looks to defend but gets a thickish outside edge to deep backward point for a single.
Kasun Rajitha bowls this slightly back of a length and in line with the stumps, Rahmat Shah stands tall and blocks the ball to mid on.
A fraction short and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran flicks this ball straight into the hands of the mid-wicket fielder.
Goes back to bowling full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran defends this solidly towards mid off.

FOUR! That is a poor ball and it gets the deserved punishment! Maheesh Theekshana bowls this slightly short and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran rocks back in the crease and cuts this towards deep point for four runs.
Another full delivery drifting into the pads, Rahmat Shah eases this down to long on and takes another single.
Goes full once again and in line with the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran whips this down to long on and takes one.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this on a yorker length but angling down leg, Ibrahim Zadran looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On a good length once again and outside off, Rahmat Shah defends this solidly towards cover.

FOUR! That is a good-looking shot to get off the mark! Kasun Rajitha bowls this one outside the off pole and on a good length, Rahmat Shah walks down the pitch and punches the ball past the diving mid on fielder for a lovely boundary.
This is on a good length and served outside the off pole, Rahmat Shah defends this to the left of the bowler.
Goes full and into the pads, Rahmat Shah clips this towards mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Another outswinger served full and well outside the off stump, Rahmat Shah is watchful as he leaves this one alone.
Rahmat Shah walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Kasun Rajitha, the newly married man, strikes and the dangerous Rahmanullah Gurbaz has to depart! Kasun Rajitha bowls this slightly back of a length and outside the off pole at 136 clicks. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stands back and looks to go for the expansive shot but gets an inside edge and the ball crashes against the stumps. Sri Lanka have drawn first blood here.
Goes back to bowling full and outside the off pole, Rahmanullah Gurbaz hits this to mid off and takes off for a quick single to keep strike.
Slightly short once again and angling towards leg, Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips this towards mid-wicket.
Pulls his length back a fraction and on off stump, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes back in the crease and plays this towards mid on.
Bowls a straighter delivery outside the off stump, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets a stride forward and defends the ball back towards the bowler.
Bowls this one really full and just outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks this towards cover.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls a loopy delivery drifting into the stumps on a fuller length, Ibrahim Zadran knocks this down to long on to get off the mark with a single.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? We are going to see some spin as Maheesh Theekshana will bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! This has been beautifully timed! In line with the stumps and a touch fuller, Rahmanullah Gurbaz plays this with a straight bat and punches it down the ground to long on for his first boundary.
Gets this closer to the stumps but keeps bowling on a good length, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is well behind this one as he blocks this solidly.
Bowls this on a good length as well and outside the off pole, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves this one alone.
A gentle outswinger, outside off, Gurbaz walks forward and pushes inside the line, only to get beaten.

Shout for an lbw! The umpire shakes his head and gestures that it's too high. Sri Lanka don't agree and Dasun Shanaka takes the DRS. Coming to the delivery... It's an inswinger, landing on a good length around off at 131 kph and nipping back in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is caught on the back foot in his attempt to work it on the leg side. He misses and is rapped on the pads. DRS time - No UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows that it's clipping the top of the leg stump. Umpire's call.
Kasun Rajitha bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole. Rahmanullah Gurbaz charges down the wicket but gets beaten by the slight movement away from the bat.

The game is about to begin. The umpires and the Sri Lankan players make their way out onto the field. The fielders spread out across the ground as Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran stride out to the middle to open the inning for Afghanistan. Kasun Rajitha, the newly married man, has been handed the new ball and he will begin proceedings. Let's play...

Pitch Report - Farveez Mahroof is in the middle. He says it is a brand new pitch, hard in nature and the grass will hold the pitch together throughout the game. Claims that the score will most likely be lower. Mentions that the hard ball will hold true initially but as the ball gets worn out, the spinners will come into play. Ends by saying that 260 should be a decent total on the board.

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka, says they would have liked to bat first too. He mentions that he expects the bowlers to bowl the same way as they did in the last game. Informs that there are two changes. Admits that there is a bit of pressure but winning the game and gaining the points is crucial.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan says that they will bat first. Explains that the decision is because of the pitch and it is more difficult to bat at night than it is during the day. Informs there is one change to their playing eleven. Claims that winning the series is important as it will be a big achievement.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Dunith Wellalage (In place of Dhananjaya Lakshan), Maheesh Theekshana, Asitha Fernando (In place of Lahiru Kumara), Kasun Rajitha.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Rahmat Shah, Gulbadin Naib, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Noor Ahmad (In place of Yamin Ahmadzai).
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Afghanistan. They have elected to BAT first.

There is loads of cricketing action taking place worldwide at the moment with India taking on New Zealand in the third and final ODI while the first Test between Australia and West Indies is underway at Perth. The Indians were staring down the barrel of a second defeat but the match has been delayed due to rain. 18 overs have been bowled so far in the second innings and if the rain continues to pour the game will have no result and New Zealand will seal the series 1-0. On the other hand, Australia have gotten off to a great start on Day 1 on the back of an unbeaten century from Marnus Labuschagne. Do switch tabs to catch the updates but join us shortly for the toss.

Afghanistan have put on quite a show away from home starting the series in dominating fashion but may have just got away with it in the second game courtesy of the rain. Their top order has been firing and a complete batting performance in the first game allowed them to set up a convincing win. However, as witnessed in the second match, they are susceptible to a middle-order collapse and need to be careful going into this game. Their fast bowlers have been in great rhythm, claiming wickets with ease, and they have a strong spin contingent who may come into play in this game. With a potentially massive series win in sight, we expect the Afghans to come out roaring in this game. Will they clinch the trophy in this game? Or will the hosts share the spoils? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

Sri Lanka would have hoped for their bowlers to put on a strong performance right at the beginning but a poor performance in the opening fixture cost them the game. They have shown that their bowling unit can be quite a handful on its day and they will be hoping to continue the momentum from the last match. Even though they had a small target to chase before rain played spoilsport in the last fixture, there was no guarantee that they would achieve the target. The form of the batters has been circumspect and they will need to start looking at building their inning to get to a big score. Super League points are still at stake and with the possibility of point reductions, Sri Lanka will want to win all their remaining four games.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of the third and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Afghanistan at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium as we are about to decide which way this series goes. Afghanistan have an unassailable lead going into this game but a series win will boost their morale in preparation for the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup, having managed to qualify directly for the main event. Sri Lanka are destined to play the qualifiers before the global tournament but will not want to add to the disappointment by losing this series at home. We anticipate this to be a cracking battle between two teams that may have little to lose but definitely have a lot to gain.
